class.name: TdJsonClient
class.description: An instance of a TDLib client. Use [code]TdJsonManager.create_client()[/code] or [code]TdJsonClient.create()[/code] to create a new instance. Use [code]send[/code] to send requests and receive responses via the [signal]response_received[/signal] signal.

method.name: close_and_destroy
method.description: Safely closes and destroys the TDLib client instance. After calling this method, the client id of instance will be 0.

method.name: create
method.description: Creates a TDLib client instance and returns it.

method.name: get_client_id
method.description: Returns the client ID of the session.

method.name: send
method.description: Sends a request to the TDLib client. May be called from any thread.

method.name: set_bot_token
method.description: Sets the authentication token of a bot and logs in when TDLib reaches [code]authorizationStateWaitPhoneNumber[/code].

signal.name: response_received
signal.description: Emits when a response or update is received for this client.
